column1: # Directories that are self-contained by design carry copies of files that also
# live in a canonical location. Copying is the intended trade; silent drift is
# not. scripts/check_vendored_copies.py compares each pair, accepting the
# differences a copy is supposed to have -- see that script's docstring.
# Two vendoring styles are registered here:
#                   domain-agentic-resources/. Directory shape is reproduced, so
#   flat re-file    domain-idea-to-product/stage-N/ and the research toolkit
#                   gather prompts from many domains into stage directories, so
#                   their links are re-pointed for the new depth.
# Deliberately NOT registered, because they are adapted rather than copied and a
#   portable-prompt-system/guides/  - flattens link paths and drops
#                   repo-specific guidance so the folder works standalone.
#   agentic-system-factory/templates/  - extends the authoring templates with
#                   machine-readable markers its own scripts/check_gate.py parses.
# Both still go stale; refreshing them is a judgement call, not a sync.
